## Markdown hooks

- `unbold` is now written in Rust and builds with Cargo, like `unslop`. Repositories using it need a Rust toolchain instead of Go. Its output is unchanged.
- `unslop --version` is removed.

## Other changes

- `shellcheck` runs ShellCheck directly. Its arguments and exclusions are unchanged.
- The README links to `example_conf/` instead of repeating its `prek.toml`. No example config changed in this release; only the `rev` needs updating.
